stories.text: Three stories. The reason is observed and compared. The comparison can fail when Lean's reason is deliberately wrong. And a refusal whose reason cannot be observed says why, so the book keeps an honest limit.

requirements.text: The run captures each refused transaction with the outputs it spends and the node's parameters. A test-owned build adds traces to the same validator source and toolchain, checked by rebuilding the deployed hashes. The traced script gets the deployed parameters and the very arguments the ledger built. The deployed bytes must reproduce the refusal first. One user trace is the chain-side reason; anything else is recorded as unobserved with its cause. Setup failures, budget exhaustion, timeouts and model-derived reasons earn nothing. A different reason fails the row after its evidence is written; an unobserved reason keeps the row and is published with its cause. A control with a wrong Lean reason must fail, an accepting control must pass and is checked in CI, and CI counts every refused step from the receipts. Every live refusal is classified against Lean itself: compared whenever the runner asked the model, which no label can undo, and published as a missing comparison otherwise. Nothing on chain, in Lean or in the constitution changes.

success-criteria.text: Every refused step CI compares with Lean shows a traced reason equal to Lean's, both hashes and a capture identity, and every other refusal shows its reason or cause and its class. The wrong-reason control fails and its restoration passes. The toolchain check and accepting control pass, and the deployed hashes are unchanged.

clarifications.text: A runner that only attributes a refusal does not put it outside Lean: it is classified, and a missing comparison is published. The phase-one reject row is a lead conflict with Lean, sent to the epic. The operator chose one self-contained receipt, so the receipt grows by one optional object. For the phase-one reject the operator kept Lean and asked for the validator to be repaired in a separate ticket. Texts outside the fence stay unchanged; a documentation follow-up is prepared once evidence exists. Open validity intervals stay a named non-goal.

authority-and-evidence.text: Issue 287 under epic 209, on base 3f04e50 with constitution 1.11.0. Lean's reasons are the oracle. The replay is script execution on captured context, distinct from the chain's own execution, and the book says so.
